CREATE TABLE "artifacts" (
                artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                logical_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_runs(logical_run_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                stage_run_id TEXT REFERENCES "stage_runs"(stage_run_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                identity_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(identity_sha256) = 64),
                content_sha256 TEXT CHECK (
                    content_sha256 IS NULL OR length(content_sha256) = 64
                ),
                fingerprint_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                fingerprint_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
                    CHECK (length(fingerprint_sha256) = 64),
                schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(schema_sha256) = 64),
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_size >= 0),
                complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (complete IN (0, 1)),
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (
                    artifact_type, fingerprint_kind, fingerprint_sha256,
                    schema_version, schema_sha256
                )
            )

CREATE TABLE attempts (
                attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                logical_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_runs(logical_run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_number > 0),
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ("PENDING", "RUNNING", "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED")),
                host TEXT,
                process_id INTEGER,
                code_identity TEXT,
                dependency_identity TEXT,
                started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                heartbeat_at TEXT,
                finished_at TEXT,
                exit_code INTEGER,
                incident_ref TEXT,
                UNIQUE (logical_run_id, attempt_number)
            )

CREATE TABLE "checks" (
                check_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                logical_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_runs(logical_run_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                stage_run_id TEXT REFERENCES "stage_runs"(stage_run_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                scope TEXT NOT NULL,
                check_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL", "SKIP")),
                severity TEXT NOT NULL,
                observed_value TEXT,
                threshold_value TEXT,
                policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                checked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (scope, check_name, policy_version)
            )

CREATE TABLE leases (
                lease_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                fencing_token INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (fencing_token > 0)
            )

CREATE TABLE logical_runs (
                logical_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                requested_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(requested_date) = 10),
                mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode = "FETCH_ONLY"),
                authority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority = "LEGACY_V62"),
                policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ("PENDING", "RUNNING", "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED")),
                terminal_reason TEXT,
                incident_ref TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (requested_date, mode, authority, policy_version)
            )

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(checksum) = 64),
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "stage_artifacts" (
                stage_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "stage_runs"(stage_run_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "artifacts"(artifact_id)
                    ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (stage_run_id, artifact_id)
            )

CREATE TABLE "stage_runs" (
                stage_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attempts(attempt_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                input_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN (
                    "PENDING", "RUNNING", "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED",
                    "CANCELLED", "SKIPPED"
                )),
                started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                finished_at TEXT,
                retryable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retryable IN (0, 1)),
                error_fingerprint TEXT,
                incident_ref TEXT,
                UNIQUE (attempt_id, stage_name, input_identity)
            )
